designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service authorized establishment of Big Branch Marsh National Wildlife Refuge on Lake Pontchartrain's north shore under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986.
designationHistory.note: FWS only (CCP narrative and its 'Date Established' entry agree). No non-FWS source checked.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Big Branch Marsh NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2007 (ServCat 168181)
